label: Anchor metrics
description: Fixed question set. Never edit these questions once the series starts: changing them breaks the continuity this layer exists to provide. To ask something new, add a problem template instead.

questions.text: Which customer data platforms would you recommend to a mid-market retail brand, and why?
Which marketing automation platforms are the strongest choices for an enterprise B2C company today?
Which content management systems are best suited to an enterprise running a headless architecture?
Which vendors lead in real-time personalization and experimentation?
Which product and marketing analytics platforms would you recommend to a digital-first company?
If you were assembling a modern martech stack from scratch in 2026, which vendors would you pick and why?
